flags: City check: 500 Barber Ln, Milpitas, CA 95035 is on the site's Contact page, footer and schema.org data, and in the Instagram bio. It matches Glenn's page (Milpitas • Goods).

Hours come from the site. The Contact page table, the footer on every page and the schema.org data agree: Mon-Thu 11:00 AM-9:30 PM, Fri 11:00 AM-10:30 PM, Sat 11:30 AM-10:30 PM, Sun 11:30 AM-9:30 PM. The Instagram screenshots show no hours, so there is no conflict.

Lunch vs dinner: there is no separate dinner price. Lunch at $25.95 is Mon-Fri 11am-4pm only. Silver ($35.95), Gold ($43.95) and Premium ($65.95) are 'Available all day' at one price. No weekend or dinner surcharge is published.

Child pricing goes by height, not age (menu page Dining Guidelines): under 40″ dine free, 40″–50″ half price, over 50″ full price. No child dollar amounts are printed, so I made no separate child items and added the rule to each tier's desc instead.

Other Dining Guidelines on the menu page: at most 10 orders at a time per table, 90-minute limit per seating, excess leftovers may be charged, no outside food or drinks, 18% service fee for parties of 6 or more.

Left out: about 80 food items on the menu page (Wagyu Selections, Other Proteins, Sushi Rolls, Appetizers, Sides) with no individual prices, because they are included in the AYCE tiers. The site does not say which items belong to which tier beyond each tier's three bullet points.

Alcohol: the site mentions a full bar (sake, craft cocktails, Japanese beer, wine) but prices no alcohol, so no alcohol lines appear. The Beverages list says 'Priced separately — not included in all-you-can-eat tiers' and is all non-alcoholic. I kept Pina Colada Smoothie as listed there; the site does not say it contains alcohol.

order_url is null. The site's Reserve / Reserve a Table buttons go to Yelp Reservations (https://www.yelp.com/reservations/wagyu-grill-ayce-milpitas). Yelp is a listing site, so the main session should decide whether to link it. There is no own online-ordering page.

Name: the site calls itself 'Wagyu Grill' with alternateName '牛浪人 Wagyu Grill'. The Instagram display name is '牛浪人 Wagyu Grill AYCE Barbeque, Sushi & Bar' and the logo reads '牛浪人 Wagyu Grill / ayce barbeque, sushi & bar'. I used '牛浪人 Wagyu Grill'. The 'Barbeque' spelling is theirs and was kept.

site_kind 'own': a real multi-page site on their own domain (Home, About, Menu, Gallery, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Accessibility), footer 'Powered by Tooo.ai'. All pages loaded with plain curl; no Playwright was needed and nothing was blocked.
No email is published on the site or in the screenshots. The phone is written '+1 (408) 649-3106' on the site and in the screenshot.
The Instagram reels grid shows a Father's Day special (free Häagen-Dazs ice cream for every dad, June 21). It is a past promotion and was not included.

Logo: cropped the site's logo image (white square with 牛浪人 X mark, ronin-bull illustration and 'Wagyu Grill' bar) from 246614_IMG_5584. The source is a little soft or low-res, so a clean original from the site (images/logo-white.png) or Instagram may be better.
On review: their Reserve buttons go to Yelp Reservations, a listing site, so no order link.

Name: the site header, H1 and <title> say 'Meat Time Yakiniku' (logo: 'MEAT TIME / YAKINIKU JAPAN'); the Instagram display name and Toast say 'Meat Time'; Tock says 'Meat Time - Milpitas'. I used 'Meat Time Yakiniku'.

Hours conflict: their Toast ordering page (linked from the site's Services page) still shows OLDER hours: Sun 11am-3pm & 5pm-9pm, Mon-Thu 5pm-9pm, Fri 5pm-11pm, Sat 11am-3pm & 5pm-11pm. Toast online ordering is turned off ('Online ordering is currently unavailable'). The brief's rule says two disagreeing first-party sources mean hours null. I kept the site hours because the Instagram post is explicitly headed 'NEW STORE HOURS' and matches the site and Tock, so Toast looks stale. Set hours to null if you want to follow the rule strictly.
Instagram grid also shows a 'SORRY WE ARE CLOSED 09.18 - 09.21, We will reopen on Tuesday 09.22' post. That closure has already passed (today is 2026-09-29), so hours are unaffected.

Happy hour times, as printed on the Happy Hour tab: 'monday - thursday all day, fri & sat 9 pm to close, sunday 8 pm to close'. Happy-hour food and the one non-alcoholic drink are in section 'Happy Hour'. Drop that section if you only want regular prices.

Left out, alcohol: all of the Drinks tab except Soft Drink (beer, draft, chu-hi, shochu, fruit liquor, sake, small sake), plus the happy-hour Barebottle beer, Kirin ice bucket, Takara chu-hi, Iichiko shot, Umepon, Sapporo and Suntory taps.

Left out, no price: the Sauces lists (golden egg-yolk sauce, green onion sauce, shio koji tare, sweet miso, nanban miso, chili paste, sesame oil) and every AYCE item that is included in a plan price. AYCE 'SHINSHU WAGYU YAKISHABU - KABURI' (rib cap) has '4 oz' in its price slot, followed by a nameless '$10 / plate' entry. That is almost certainly Kaburi 4 oz at $10/plate, but the site does not state it that way, so it is left out.

AYCE: the $4/plate lines are extra charges on the Base Plan (the same cuts are included in the Premium Plan). The $5/$7/$14 lines are extra charges under 'Japanese Wagyu & Exclusive Cuts' on the Premium Plan. The $10 food-waste charge is kept in the Base Plan desc. The FAQ says AYCE has 'reasonable pricing for kids 5-12' and that kids under 8 eat free on Mondays and Tuesdays. No kids' price is published.
Premium Plan desc is condensed from the site's 'includes all items from BASE PLAN and items below' plus its listed extras (kainomi, ichibo, miso rosu, harami, seafood & vegetables, wagyu fried rice).

Bento catering: not priced anywhere first-party. The contact page says 'Explore our Menu to see available Bento selections', but the Menu page has no bento tab. The Services page links daily yakiniku bento takeout to Toast (toasttab.com/local/order/meat-time-260-s-abel-st), and that page shows no menu, only 'Online ordering is currently unavailable. Please contact the restaurant to place an order.' The site says premium bentos for office catering are by call or the contact form.

Not priced: Omakase course sets and private events ('Call to make a private reservation'). Nabe Day (Motsu Nabe hot pot every other Thursday, booked on Tock, 'Different price for each Nabe Day'; the Tock event pages were not read for prices because they are one-off dated events). Taco Tuesday (Japanese-inspired tacos, every Tuesday, no price).

Tock (www.exploretock.com/meat-time-milpitas, their own booking page from the IG bio and site) lists no menu prices, just reservations for 1-10 guests and '$$'. It is used as order_url because Toast online ordering is off.
Blocks: Toast and Tock both returned Cloudflare 403 'Just a moment' to curl. Each loaded normally in one headless Playwright visit with no challenge shown, so nothing was bypassed.

Typos fixed: 'thick beef brothe' to 'broth', 'serve with wagyu bits' to 'served with' (House Curry Rice), 'seasweed' to 'seaweed' (Wakame Soup), 'KIMINO SPARKING JUICE' to 'SPARKLING'. Names are kept in the site's all-caps.

flags: City check: 1410 El Paseo de Saratoga, San Jose, CA 95130 is on the site's San Jose page, in the Instagram bio and on their Chowbus page. It matches Glenn's 'San Jose' page. Glenn filed it under 'Goods', but this is a sit-down restaurant (wagyu sukiyaki/shabu AYCE plus a hand roll bar), so the category may need to be Food.

Name varies by source: the site page says 'Wagyu Master San Jose', the site logo says 'Wagyu Master Shabu House', Instagram says 'Wagyu Master Sukiyaki', Resy says 'Wagyu Master Sukiyaki House - San Jose' and Chowbus says 'WAGYU MASTER SUKIYAKI (San Jose, CA)'. I used the San Jose page's name.

The brand has several locations (the site also has Pasadena, NYC/Chubby Nori and Arizona pages; the Instagram bio names Manhattan NY and a Peoria AZ soft opening). This is NOT one menu shared by all locations. The menus used are the ones on the San Jose page, and their files are named 'Wagyu-Master-Nori-San-Jose-Menu' and 'WMSJ_DRINK_MENU'. The NYC page has its own separate menu images. The menu images themselves do not name a city.

The menus exist only as images on their own site, but the text is clearly legible, so I transcribed them (full text is in raw_b_wagyumastersanjose_menu_images.txt). Each image shows a regular price in black and a member price in red. I used the regular price as cents and put the member price in desc.

The Shabu AYCE menu lists hand rolls, sides (Vegetable Platter, Tempura Platter, Chicken Karaage, Wagyu Curry Rice, Wagyu Gyudon, Udon, Salmon Carpaccio, Yellowtail Carpaccio, Wagyu Tallow Chicken Wings), 'Deserts' (sic: Matcha Warabi Mochi, Matcha Mille Crêpe Cake, Matcha Ice Cream, Vanilla Ice Cream, Egg Tart) and five broths (Spicy Miso Tonkotsu, Creamy Tomato, Bonito Dashi, House Special Sukiyaki, Wagyu Bone Broth), none with prices. These presumably come with AYCE and were left out as unpriced items. The menu does not say whether the AYCE prices are per person, so I did not add that.
The fourth image in the San Jose page's Menu section (0403_WMSan-Jose_Menu-merged-4) is a Chubby Club membership-benefits graphic with no menu prices.
Alcohol: the San Jose drink menu image has only non-alcoholic drinks, so nothing was left out. Lychee Sparkling Water ($4.99) appears only on the Chowbus page and is included.

Typo fixes: 'Iced Olong Tea' became 'Iced Oolong Tea' (Chowbus spells it oolong). The AYCE menu's 'Yellowtail with cirtrus soy' uses the Handroll Bar menu's spelling, 'citrus'. '* Available only when order Sukiyaki base' was reworded to 'only when ordering the Sukiyaki base'.

The 'To-go:' sections come from their Chowbus online-ordering page (pos.chowbus.com store 23506, linked from wagyumastershabu.com under Order Online > San Jose; it is server-rendered, so curl worked). Each item there shows two prices: one with a 'point' icon (a points price) and a grey regular price. I used the regular price. Chowbus writes item names in lowercase and descriptions in Title Case; I capitalized the names and put the descriptions in sentence case. Drop these sections if the page should show only the dine-in menu.

Chowbus hand roll prices differ from the dine-in Handroll Bar menu (for example Tuna Roll is $9 vs $7, Wagyu Ribeye Yaki Shabu Roll $14 vs $12, Mega Chubby Roll $52 vs $50; the 3/4/5/6 Hand Roll Sets are $23+/$28+/$39+/$48+ there vs $21/$28/$35/$39 dine-in, and are described as 'chef-selected'). Only the dine-in hand roll prices are in items. The Chowbus hand roll and set listings were not added as duplicates.

Hours come from the 'Hours of Operation' block on the site's San Jose page. The Chowbus page shows different pickup hours: Mon-Thu 11:30am-2:30pm & 5:30pm-9pm, Fri 11:30am-2:30pm & 5:30pm-10pm, Sat 11:30am-10pm, Sun 11:30am-9pm. These mostly line up with the site's last-seating times and look like online-ordering windows, not dining hours, so I kept the site's dining hours instead of setting hours to null. The brief's strict rule would null them; that call is left to the main session.

Phone: wagyumastershabu.com does not print a phone number anywhere (its Contact Us page is only a form with a CAPTCHA, which I did not touch). +1 (408) 549-7891 comes from the store info on their Chowbus ordering page, which the site links. Glenn's screenshots have no Instagram Contact sheet.
Email: none printed for the restaurant. Instagram shows an Email button, but the address is not visible. The only address on the site is hr@chubbgroup.com, for job resumes, and it was not used.
Booking: 'Book Now' on the San Jose page opens Resy (venue 98329, 'Wagyu Master Sukiyaki House - San Jose'). order_url is set to their Chowbus ordering page instead.

Instagram: the handle 'wagyumastersukiyaki' comes from Glenn's screenshot. Its bio says the account is 'Curated by @joinchubbyclub' (Chubby Group). The site also links instagram.com/wagyumastersanjose, which is not in the screenshots and was not checked.
No blocks: every page loaded with curl, and Playwright was not needed.
On review: the phone is from their own Chowbus ordering; their site prints none.
